pa_server.label: PulseAudio server address
pa_server.description: PulseAudio server socket or TCP address. Leave empty to auto-detect from the PULSE_SERVER environment variable or the default socket path (e.g. /run/audio/pulse.sock on HAOS).

include_monitors.label: Include monitor sources
include_monitors.description: When enabled, sink monitor sources (loopbacks of audio outputs) also appear alongside hardware inputs, enabling capture of any output stream.

input_gain_db.label: Input gain (dB)
input_gain_db.description: Software gain applied after the ADC, before streaming to Music Assistant. Use this to compensate for low line-level sources without increasing ALSA capture gain. Range: -20 to +20 dB. 0 = unity gain (no adjustment).
